text:
ana-sales: LargeCare wants a 1-week POC in their AWS account. Requirement: no internet egress for inference. They mentioned an inline TLS proxy that rewrites SNI. Need guidance + a paste-ready firewall/routing snippet.
devin-net: devin-net: TL;DR: PrivateLink (interface endpoints) for control-plane; data plane can be fully intranet-only if we pull models from their private S3 and run our agent in their VPC. Peering vs PrivateLink: peering = L3 routes, PrivateLink = ENIs + private hosted zone.
mike-sre: mike-sre: Checklist I send customers:
- Allow outbound TCP/443 to PrivateLink ENI CIDR(s)
- Allow UDP/TCP 53 to resolver
- Allow sts.amazonaws.com over 443 for role assumption
- Optional TCP/22 for support bastion
If they cannot disable SNI rewrite, recommend Dedicated in-VPC deployment (enterprise) for POC.
julia-sec: julia-sec: Security notes: TLS interception will break cert validation — need passthrough for our CNs (*.redwood-inference.com and control-plane.<region>.privatelink.redwood.ai) or exception for our ENI CIDRs. Also request a customer IAM role arn:aws:iam::[acct]:role/redwood-poc-s3 for artifact pulls.
ana-sales: ana-sales: Can you give me a small allowlist snippet I can paste into change ticket?
devin-net: devin-net: Sure — replace CIDRs/IPs with values we provide:
```
# Redwood POC allowlist (example)
TCP 443 10.210.5.0/24   # PrivateLink ENI block
TCP 443 54.23.12.45     # optional explicit endpoint IP
TCP 443 sts.amazonaws.com
UDP/TCP 53 <onprem-dns-ip>
```
Also: add Route53 resolver conditional forwarder for privatelink private zone.
mike-sre: mike-sre: Routing notes: make routes to the ENI CIDR more specific than any 0.0.0.0/0 proxy route. If using split-tunnel VPN, ensure prefixes for the ENI are routed via the VPC-local attachment, not the internet proxy.
julia-sec: julia-sec: I'll attach SOC2 summary and KMS integration docs. Ask the customer whether host-level inspection applies to ENI-to-ENI traffic; if yes, they'll need an exception.
ticket-bot: ticket-bot: Created ticket NET-9812 "LargeCare POC network runbook" and scheduled review 2024-05-02 11:00 PDT.
ana-sales: ana-sales: Thanks — I'll send this to the customer and confirm if they can provide the S3 role and disable SNI rewrite. :thumbsup:
